body:
Pass 13. Confirmed your hot-loop criterion landed: kernel.R and task.R now have zero object.size calls and task.R max_*_bytes is down 17 -> 2. That closes one of the original review findings.

New p2, bd-01KZXJ882H70KWBCHQ4HAZZN50: measurement-kernel.R still has it, and it is outside your Epic 4 reservation so it would be easy to miss. Two object.size calls inside the per-feature-block loop at :332-339, and more pointedly :236-238 sizes buffers by allocating them - object.size(matrix(0, rows, columns)), four calls at :242-245, ~128 MB of allocation at q=200/feature_block=20000 inside a memory preflight. Exact replacement is 8*rows*columns + 216, verified identical across shapes. Also noted on Epic 8 since that inflates the very RSS number the gate measures.
